verdict.rationale: Daryanani offers O-1 extraordinary-ability visas and serves technology clients (docs-2, docs-5). It says it immediately sets a case strategy and identifies foreseeable issues (docs-16), and an attorney reviews all work before submission (docs-15). Its entrepreneur blog post discusses O-1 eligibility for business operators, but none of this shows a structured, documented evaluation of the founder's evidence against the USCIS O-1A criteria. Missing for 10: a documented O-1A qualification assessment process, a criterion-by-criterion evaluation against the USCIS standards, a written pre-filing assessment deliverable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
